item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: The festival of the day of the dead is coming up next week, and you are invited to bring a picture of a loved one who has died. Pictures are displayed along with flowers and traditional Mexican decorations. If you would like to bring a picture for this new display, please come see Mr. Vonesch at the chaplaincy office today

item.title: A message from Ms Dawson:
item.description: Thank you to all the Grade 7s and 8s who came out to vote in our student municipal election last week. Between our advance voters and day-of voters, we had a turn out of 72% of eligible voters, compared to 30% in the community of Russell. A big shout out to the WEB crew who worked as pollsters and kept people moving through our polling station quickly and easily. Thank you everyone again, see you at the next election, and remember how fast and simple this process is when you're old enough to vote for real!
